facts.fact: The digital transformation ministry (MTNIMA) held a three-day workshop to develop a unified framework of public digital-service standards to ensure greater interoperability, and presented a technical study and implementation mechanism for stakeholder feedback before full adoption; the document gives no workshop date, so the published date is used.
facts.system: National framework for public digital-services standards

systems.owner: MTNIMA with GIZ (Germany), EUR 4m, launched January 2025
